shared_elements: animal in profile with four legs
elongated horizontal band or bar motif
figures organised in stacked horizontal registers
weathered stone as the carrying surface
justification: Both surfaces present small profile animal figures and elongated bar-like motifs distributed in roughly stacked horizontal registers across a vertical stone face, which is the clearest correspondence. Everything else diverges: A is crisp, deeply modelled relief in warm sunlit stone with a dense, deliberately framed composition, whereas B is a faint linear red-pigment (or lightly incised) scatter on flat grey rock with no framing, no depth and far looser spacing.
